text: dsh-scope 是面向 DSH Web 的用量统计插件。它在侧边栏面板展示跨会话的累计 Token 摘要、52 周活动热力图、按模型区分的每日趋势和用量占比，并在会话标题处显示上下文窗口占用、组成和缓存命中率。面板还可查看 DeepSeek 账户余额与奖励信息。数据由本地 DSH 会话记录和账户服务提供；用量缓存保存在 DSH 存储目录，不需要为插件单独配置 API Key。

dsh-scope adds a DSH Web sidebar for lifetime token totals, a 52-week heatmap, model trends and usage shares, plus a session-header context lens. An optional page shows DeepSeek balance and bonus details. It reads local session data and stores a usage cache in the DSH data directory.

能不能按天查看模型用量变化
我想用热力图回顾一年的使用情况

How much of the current context window is occupied?

dsh-scope 的功能「跨会话 Token 统计」：聚合 DSH 持久会话和活动会话中的 Token 用量，按天与模型汇总，并提供累计摘要。 通过侧栏面板或会话标题触发，读取本地会话数据或可用的账户服务。
dsh-scope 的功能「用量趋势与热力图」：选择时间范围查看每日模型趋势和模型用量占比，也可切换每日、每周或累计热力图。 通过侧栏面板或会话标题触发，读取本地会话数据或可用的账户服务。
dsh-scope 的功能「上下文透镜」：在会话标题处查看窗口占用、system/tools/messages 组成、会话 Token 分桶和缓存命中率。 通过侧栏面板或会话标题触发，读取本地会话数据或可用的账户服务。
dsh-scope 的功能「DeepSeek 账户面板」：在侧栏面板查看账户钱包、奖励余额及账户资料；账户服务不可用时显示不可用状态。 通过侧栏面板或会话标题触发，读取本地会话数据或可用的账户服务。

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

**Usage statistics for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`)** — a lifetime dashboard of your token usage across every session, plus a context lens for the session you are in.

dsh-scope README · dsh-scope：DeepSeek Harness computes rich token accounting and then shows you none of it. `dsh-scope` surfaces it in two places.

> One of several `dsh` plugins developed under
> [`dsh-plugins/`](https://github.com/helloxkk) — each an independent
> repo with its own release cadence.
dsh-scope README · Usage statistics (sidebar footer)：Open from the sidebar foot — a label when the sidebar is wide, an icon on the rail.

dsh-scope README · Usage statistics (sidebar footer)：- **Lifetime summary** — cumulative and peak-day tokens, longest session, current and longest streaks.
- **Token activity** — a 52-week heatmap in three modes: **daily** (each day colored on its own usage), **weekly** (each column summed) and **cumulative** (a running total across columns). One grid reads either as a year at a glance or as growth over time.
- **Time range** — last 7 or 30 days, driving both charts below.
- **Daily token trend** — one line per model, with a wrapping legend and per-day tooltip. Only models used inside the window appear as series.
- **Model usage** — a donut with the window total in the center and a percentage list beside it.
dsh-scope README · Usage statistics (sidebar footer)：The whole panel is one request to the plugin's own loopback-only endpoint.

dsh-scope README · Context Lens (session header)：Window occupancy for the current session: a live occupancy ring in the header that opens into a segmented system / tools / messages composition bar, per-bucket session totals, and KV-cache hit rate. It reads the official `token-meter` session projections through `useProjection` — no RPC, no custom wire protocol.

dsh-scope README · Requirements：- `dsh` ≥ `0.1.0-rc.6` on your `PATH` (verified against `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.2.0-rc.2`)
- Node.js 22.18+ or 24.11+ (for building from source only)

dsh-scope README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-scope
dsh web                             # restart dsh to load the plugin
```

`<profile>` is the directory under `~/.dsh/profiles/` that your dsh runs from — the Desktop app uses `desktop`.

<details>
<summary>Install from source</summary>

```sh
git clone https://github.com/helloxkk/dsh-scope.git
cd dsh-scope
npm install && npm run build
node scripts/install.mjs <profile>   # e.g. desktop, headless, rescue

dsh-scope README · Install：The script refuses an unknown profile rather than guessing.

</details>

The installer copies `lib/`, `cordis.patch.yml`, and `package.json` into the profile's `node_modules` and appends the bundle insert to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It is idempotent — safe to re-run after every rebuild.

dsh-scope README · Uninstall：```sh
rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-scope

dsh-scope README · then remove the "# dsh-scope" block from ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml：rm -f ~/.dsh/storages/dsh-scope-cache.json   # optional: drop the fold cache
```

text: dsh-scope README · How it works：**Host half** (`lib/index.js`) — one read-only, loopback-fenced endpoint, `GET /api/dsh-scope/days`.

dsh-scope README · How it works：Aggregation is incremental. Per-session fold state is cached in memory and persisted to `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-scope-cache.json`, and each request folds only the events added since the last fold. Live sessions fold their in-memory tail; persisted sessions skip work entirely while the backend's opaque revision is unchanged, and otherwise read only the new suffix, with contiguity checks and a full refold when a log was truncated or rewritten. Steady-state cost stays O(new events) no matter how large the logs grow.

dsh-scope README · How it works：Fold semantics mirror `dsh-token-meter`'s `tokenUsage` projection. A usage sample rides an `assistant/chunk` (`data.chunk.type === "usage"`) or an `assistant/message` (`data.usage`). A repeated sample for the same (turn, step) **replaces** the earlier value rather than double counting, re-attributed to the later event's day and model. Model attribution follows `assistant/message`'s `data.message.source`, falling back to the last `request/header` config.

dsh-scope README · How it works：Beyond token buckets, the fold counts `turn/start` and `tool/call` events per day (feeding the weekly and cumulative heatmap tooltips) and tracks each session's first and last event timestamps so the summary can report the longest session. The payload carries **every** model per day rather than a truncated top-N, so the trend chart and donut always cover all of them.

**Client half** (`lib/client.js`, loaded via the package's `dsh.client` declaration):

dsh-scope README · How it works：- `sidebar.footer.action` renders the usage trigger. The panel fetches `/api/dsh-scope/days` same-origin and derives every view from that single payload.
- `conversation.session.header.actions` (order 30, after the job list) renders the lens trigger. Its popover reads three official projections — `tokenUsage` (four buckets accumulated over the whole durable log), `contextPressure` (input-side window pressure plus the route's context window), and `contextBreakdown` (heuristic system/tools/message composition of the next request).
dsh-scope README · How it works：**Nothing is sent anywhere.** The endpoint refuses non-loopback callers and non-GET methods before doing any work, and no provider credentials are read.

dsh-scope README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build                          # tsdown: host ESM + browser ModuleLoader bundle
node scripts/fixture-session.mjs       # optional: write a demo session log with usage events
node scripts/install.mjs <profile>     # then restart dsh

`npm run build` emits two artifacts:

dsh-scope README · Development：- `lib/index.js` — the Node host half. `@deepseek-ai/*` stays external and resolves against the profile's own installation at runtime.
- `lib/client.js` — the browser half, wrapped in the harness ModuleLoader factory format. Platform modules (`react`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*`) stay external and resolve through the loader's injected `require`; everything else, including Recharts, is inlined.
dsh-scope README · Development：Because the harness caches plugin modules at startup, **only the client half hot-reloads**. After changing anything under `src/index.js` or `src/usage.js`, restart dsh.

dsh-scope README · Compatibility：Built and verified against `dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.2.0-rc.2` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app` bundles). The harness is in developer preview and iterates quickly — expect compatibility-breaking changes.

dsh-scope README · Compatibility：The host half reads persisted logs through whichever API the installed `sessionPersistence` exposes: `open(id, 'read')` plus `handle.read(offset)` on `0.2.x`, and the older `readFrom(id, fromSeq)` elsewhere. `list()` is normalized to `{ header, revision }` snapshots, so both shapes fold identically.

dsh imports each plugin module once at startup, so a profile config reload cannot replace host-half code: **restart dsh after rebuilding**.

dsh-scope README · Credits：The usage panel's layout, its three heatmap modes, and the month-ruler
alignment are derived from ZCode's 「应用用量」 surface
([zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode), Apache-2.0). The rendering,
data source and theming are this plugin's own. See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) for
the required attribution and the list of derived files.

Charts render with [Recharts](https://github.com/recharts/recharts) (MIT).
